_comment: Bridge from file 4: the stamp on the odds-ratio card names what no bias check can supply.

stem.en: Your odds-ratio card carries a stamp reading NO INCIDENCE, and all four bias checks passed. What is it about the 13.2 that no check can repair?

text.en: It may carry confounding, which matching on age would have repaired
It rests on only 20 cases, so a larger sample would have repaired it
It cannot say how many of all the plant's reactor workers fall ill over time, because no group was followed forward from exposure
It compares odds instead of risks, so it always overstates the true effect

explanation.en: The bias checks certify that the comparison was assembled fairly, but the study still started from 20 men who already had the tumour and 60 who did not. Nobody was followed from exposure to disease, so there is no count of new cases per head over time, and no amount of fairness in the selection can create one. That number has to come from a study that starts with people who are still well: a cohort.

hints.en: Ask what the study never did: keep a group of well men under observation as the years passed.
